Softmod · Peer Pressure

More homebrew & payloads Windows tools Dashboards & file managers Apps & utilities

Peer Pressure is a persistent Xbox 360 softmod for Xenon, Zephyr, Falcon, Jasper and Trinity motherboards. Corona and Winchester are unsupported. It requires an attached HDD; the developer recommends a mechanical drive. Read its installation wiki before changing NAND or HDD data. DashLaunch and DashLaunch plugins are not supported.

Peer Pressure 1.0.477

Official installer, supported hardware and installation documentation. Keep the matching console NAND backup and recovery information produced by the developer’s workflow.

Download installer Installation guide Project & compatibility

17559 System Update

Supplied dashboard 2.0.17559.0 download reference. Apply updates only when the softmod instructions require them for your existing setup.

17559 download page

Rock Band Blitz Trial

Supplied trial-file directory. Check the Peer Pressure instructions for the required version and layout.

Trial files

Aurora Dashboard

Phoenix / XboxUnity dashboard resources. Check Peer Pressure’s homebrew compatibility notes before installing; do not assume its NOVA or other plugin features are supported by the softmod.

More Xbox 360 homebrew & payloads

Exploit entry points, runtime payloads and the LibXenon loader, with official release builds.

Choose the route matching your console. BadUpdate and ABadAvatar start temporary sessions. FreeMyXe and XeUnshackle are payload choices for that workflow. They are separate from Peer Pressure’s persistent softmod. Follow each developer’s requirements before mixing apps or plugins.

BadUpdate 1.3

Temporary homebrew entry point for dashboard 17559, using a supported game and its matching save. The original repository is archived; read its game-specific instructions. A separate homebrew payload is required and the exploit must be run again after reboot.

17559Temporary exploitUSB
Download v1.3 Project & requirements

ABadAvatar · public beta

Alternative dashboard/avatar entry point for a temporary homebrew session. Requires the Avatar update data and an additional XEX payload. Follow the developer’s offline/profile instructions; it is separate from the persistent Peer Pressure softmod.

Avatar entry pointPublic betaTemporary session
Download public beta 1.0 Project & requirements

FreeMyXe 1.2.1

Lightweight BadUpdate payload that applies runtime patches for homebrew, XeLL and LibXenon. The release includes a XeLL build. Use it for the temporary exploit workflow; the developer explicitly rules out NAND-modifying homebrew on this setup.

BadUpdate payloadRuntime patchesLibXenon
Download 1.2.1 Project & requirements

XeUnshackle · beta 1.03

Alternative BadUpdate payload with kernel/hypervisor patches, CPU/DVD-key display and an in-memory DashLaunch module. It returns to an unmodified state after power-off. Its plugin workflow applies to BadUpdate and must not be applied to Peer Pressure.

BadUpdate payloadBetaSeparate plugin workflow
Download BETA v1.03 Project & requirements

XeLL Reloaded 0.993

Linux and LibXenon ELF loader with USB, HDD and network boot support. Choose the binary matching the documented JTAG, RGH or BadUpdate chain-loading route. This is a loader resource for an established setup, not a standalone retail-console installer.

ELF loaderLinuxJTAG / RGH / chain-load
Download v0.993 Project & requirements

Xbox 360 tools for your PC

Desktop storage, package and console-management helpers. These downloads run on Windows.

FATXplorer · Windows x64

Desktop Xbox storage explorer for mounting FATX partitions, transferring files and preparing supported drives. The linked 3.0 beta needs the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime. Review its drive-specific requirements before formatting; formatting erases the selected device.

Windows helperFATX storage3.0 beta
Download 3.0.0.27437 Beta 37 Hotfix 2 Project & requirements

Velocity · Windows

Open source desktop browser/editor for Xbox 360 packages, profiles and FATX/STFS/XDBF data. Use copies of your own files when inspecting or editing packages. This Windows build runs on your computer and does not enable homebrew on a retail console.

Windows helperPackage browserSTFS / FATX / XDBF
Download v1.0.0 cf0b84cc8b Project & requirements

XeCLI 2.0 · Windows x64

Portable console-management toolkit with a desktop terminal, file transfers, diagnostics and XEX inspection. Live console commands require an RGH/JTAG setup with a compatible XBDM plugin; some functions also require JRPC2 or FTP. Peer Pressure does not support that DashLaunch-plugin setup.

Windows helperRGH / JTAGXBDM required
Download v2.0.0 Project & requirements

Cheat trainers and modifications for popular Xbox 360 games with unlimited health, ammo, and other features.

Visual Mods

Graphics modifications, texture packs, and visual enhancements for supported Xbox 360 games.

Save Game Mods

Modified save games with unlocked content, completed progress, and enhanced character stats.

Modding Tools

Tools for creating and installing game modifications, including Horizon and Modio for save editing.

Xbox 360 Modding Safety

Risk of Brick

JTAG/RGH installation requires precise soldering and can permanently damage your console if done incorrectly.

Xbox Live Ban

Modded consoles will be permanently banned from Xbox Live. Never connect a modded console to Xbox Live.

Technical Skills Required

Installation requires advanced soldering skills and proper equipment. Consider professional installation.

NAND Backup Important

Always create and verify NAND backups before modification. This is essential for recovery.
